memory_verse.label: Bible Reference
memory_verse.text: "The fire and wood are here," Isaac said, "but where is the lamb for the burnt offering?" Abraham answered, "God himself will provide the lamb for the burnt offering, my son." And the two of them went on together. - Gen 22:7b-8 (NIV)

devotion.label: Devotion
devotion.text:
Isaac asks the question that hangs over the whole scene: "Where is the lamb?" Everything is ready except the sacrifice itself. And Abraham gives an answer of extraordinary faith: "God himself will provide the lamb." He did not know how. He did not know that a ram was already caught in a nearby thicket. He simply trusted that God would provide.

These words - "God himself will provide" - are among the most faith-filled in all of Scripture. Abraham was walking in obedience toward the unthinkable, and yet his heart rested in the conviction that God would supply what was needed. He trusted the character of God even in total darkness about the outcome.

But these words carry a weight even Abraham could not have fully grasped. "God himself will provide the lamb" is one of the great prophetic statements of the Bible. For God did, in the end, provide the Lamb - not merely the ram that would spare Isaac that day, but the true Lamb, His own Son, on this very region of Moriah generations later. When John the Baptist saw Jesus, he cried, "Look, the Lamb of God, who takes away the sin of the world!" (John 1:29).

What Abraham spoke in faith, God fulfilled in Christ. You and I could never provide the sacrifice our sins require. But God Himself has provided the Lamb. Whatever you cannot supply, look to the God who provides - supremely in Jesus, the Lamb given for you.

reflection.label: Reflection
reflection.text:
- Can you trust that "God himself will provide" even when you can't see how?
- Have you looked to Jesus, the Lamb God provided for your sin?

prayer.label: Prayer
prayer.text:
Lord, thank You that You Yourself provide what I could never supply. Thank You most of all for Jesus, the Lamb of God who takes away my sin. When I cannot see the way, help me trust that You will provide.
Amen.
